historical_access: Owner-authorized existing July10-Sep9 retrospective data; this audit re-read frozen outcomes and independently replayed20 selected events. No new optimization or parameter choice.
method: Read-only ad hoc checks executed in the local existing venv. This JSON records verified evidence; it is not a separately preregistered standalone audit builder.
changes: Only this new audit JSON was written in this audit; source builders, existing results, services and parameters untouched. No complete market or cashbook replay rerun.

checks.name: dataset_and_parent_artifact_SHA256
checks.details: Unique paths across dataset artifacts, parent manifest/aggregate sources, catalog snapshots and original feature artifact list.

checks.name: original_normalized_OHLCV_SHA256
checks.details: Every original per-market source_path/source_sha256 in authenticated parent coverage.csv.

checks.name: actual_event_unique_ids_and_all_clocks
checks.details: Unique IDs; decisions in [July10,Sep9)UTC; valid entry=decision close=next open, entry_i=decision_i+1; strictly later exit<=Sep9; interval bounds and exit_i valid.

checks.name: control_matching_parent_and_eligibility
checks.details: Same venue/asset/instrument/timeframe/arm and UTC decision week; unique number/position within parent; exact saved matching index; same causal rolling240/min60 ATR-percent bucket; not at a signal or within12 bars after a known signal; next complete bar exists.

checks.name: independent_sample_ATR_stop_fill_trailing_reconciliation
checks.details: Independent numpy TR, SMA14 seed and SMMA recurrence, then independent next-open trade loop. Compared initial stop/risk, fill and exit prices, stop ratchet, event indices/times, net return/R, conservative peak, natural/censored status. Did not call production simulate_trade.

checks.name: all_cashbook_candidate_sets_allocation_and_cash
checks.details: Every ledger event set equals full or exact matched0 source subset. Unique selected events, no overlapping same-asset holdings, <=10assets, cash nonnegative, quantity/notional agreement,10%equity/.5%risk/1%signal-turnover/.1%prior24h-turnover caps, PnL=qty*(exit-entry)-.002*notional, final NAV=100000+realizedPnL.

checks.name: all_cost_and_drawdown_summary_arithmetic
checks.details: Return and MDD match actual curve; 40/60bp stress subtracts additional .002/.004 entry notional per1000 NAV-percentage-unit; actual-turnover fee adjustment matches .001*qty*(exit-entry)/1000.

checks.name: calendar_subperiod_inherits_NAV_and_holdings
checks.details: First31 closing NAV equals last30 opening NAV; compounded two subperiod returns equal full return; entry-cohort counts partition full. No independent rerun/reset at split.

checks.name: paired_event_means_independent_units_and_Holm
checks.details: Mean excess recomputed from same actual IDs and valid random mean; asset/week→asset averaging verified; permutation_assets are unique assets, not exchange copies;16-way Holm recalculated. Random sign draws not rerun.

checks.name: source_builders_still_match_receipts
checks.details: Current bytes match dataset source_hashes and validation builder_sha256.

sample_design: Sort groups by minutes,arm; sample5 without replacement in each of4 groups with one numpy default_rng stream.

without_useless.interpretation: Removed candidates were not selected in the original full account; equal filled paths are expected, not evidence that a selected USELESS winner was removed.
Changed selected event identities demonstrate reallocation, not static subtraction. Shared quantities did not change.

limitations: Account same-asset exclusivity is exact-base identity, not independently verified economic token mapping. Unverified numeric multiplier aliases are excluded in combined scope.
This audit verifies arithmetic and implementation consistency, not the profitability or generalization of the strategy.
Funding, spread, impact and actual fees are excluded from base account;40/60bp is fixed-allocation sensitivity.
Historical tick changes and absent delisted markets are not reconstructed.
Peak R is conservative outcome information, not realized return or an entry feature.
